invariant: P06.12.01: the opportunistic sweep deletes only buckets untouched for a full day
expected: A shorter window deletes buckets still in use, so an exhausted bucket is recreated full on the source's next request: a throttle bypass anyone triggers by waiting an hour.

killingTest.fullName: auth throttle buckets (0023) > a recently exhausted bucket survives another source's sweep

invariant: P06.12.01: bounded work, one take sweeps at most 100 stale rows
expected: Without the cap one sign-in pays for every stale row a rotating scanner left behind.

killingTest.fullName: auth throttle buckets (0023) > one take sweeps at most 100 stale rows

invariant: P06.12.01: a take is granted only when the bucket holds the cost
expected: Every take is granted until the CHECK on tokens rejects it, so the ceiling is whatever the constraint happens to allow, and concurrent callers see errors instead of 429s.

killingTest.fullName: auth throttle buckets (0023) > concurrent takes never grant more than the bucket holds

invariant: X3: a request refills against the time it holds its bucket's lock
expected: The clock read on entry is older than the update of a request that took the bucket meanwhile: the refill clamps to nothing and writes an older updated_at, so the next request earns the same interval again.

killingTest.fullName: a request that waited for its bucket refills against when it got it (X3) > a newcomer that waited at saturation gets an answer, not a negative balance

invariant: X3: the sweep never waits for a stale row another transaction holds
expected: A stale row held by an in-flight call of an earlier body is waited for while this request holds the count row: a deadlock.

killingTest.fullName: a request that waited for its bucket refills against when it got it (X3) > the sweep passes over a stale row another transaction holds

invariant: X3: the sweep never locks an overflow bucket
expected: A stale overflow row is locked by the sweep and held while the request waits for the overflow lock, against a request that holds that lock and waits for the row.

killingTest.fullName: a request that waited for its bucket refills against when it got it (X3) > a sweep at saturation leaves a stale overflow bucket unlocked
